name: Waking Up
overview: Scripture portrays waking up as a sacred moment for communion with God, marked by prayer and trust in His guidance. The psalmist expresses a desire to direct prayers to the Lord early in the morning and to awaken with joy and praise, as seen in calls to 'awake, psaltery and harp.' Waking is also connected to spiritual satisfaction and the assurance of God's presence, emphasizing that even upon rising, the believer remains with the Lord and seeks His lovingkindness to know the right path.
